content: For speech recognition experiments, we ensure that our test set includes unique speakers as well as speakers that overlap with the training set, in order to allow for comparisons of the ability of the speech recognition system to generalize over seen and new speakers. For consistency, we use the same dataset splits for the machine translation experiments. The statistics in Table reflect this split.
